geometry_authority: Official user-supplied STEP R1; step_verified and step_measurements.json describe current geometry. manual_reference retains previous PDF reconstruction inputs for audit only.
coordinate_frame: southwest inner corner = (0,0), +x east, +y north, finished main floor G = z0; blue = (12-x,8-y)

effective_simulation.note: Simulation choices, not CAD material properties. Spawn base clears the STEP supply surface at 3mm.

appearance.source_figure: Fig 3-1, PDF page 23 embedded Im1.jp2, 1232x769 pixels
appearance.method: Use the embedded official rendering as a UV atlas, preserving actual source pixels and red/blue/green markings. Source has baked lighting/shadows and finite resolution; rendered colors depend on lighting.
appearance.schematic_colors: Blue control fill and yellow/green hatching in dimension diagrams are explanatory overlays, not physical floor colors. Physical appearance follows Figs 3-1 to 3-3.
appearance.step: Default: PDF surface style plus actual STEP glyphs; optional rmul_2027_native uses actual AP214 face colors. Face color is not a physical material measurement.

manual_reference.source: RoboMaster 2027 机甲大师高校联盟赛比赛规则手册 V1.0.0（20261015）

derived.note: Algebraic differences of specified dimensions, not additional measured dimensions.

inferred.note: Not specified by the manual. Geometry follows the figures; friction and spawn are simulation settings. No standard RGB/PBR/roughness or exact CAD is supplied.

limitations: STEP supplies previously undocumented geometry. CAD-to-physical-field identity and unpublished material properties still cannot be certified.
General dimensional tolerance +/-10%; battlefield angle +/-3 degrees; prop angle +/-1 degree; structures smaller than 100mm +/-5mm. Use nominal values, not random perturbations.
Interaction cards are under the extra 2mm PVC, so hidden card arrays are metadata, not visible checkerboard decorations.
The original robot uses planar VelocityControl with disabled gravity, no wheel contact/suspension/terrain following. Do not claim it can climb the 200mm deck.
The existing planar lidar is at 279.62mm: it can see over a 200mm deck and 270mm tunnel roof. A lidar-only occupancy slice differs from a chassis traversability map.
The supplied PGM conservatively blocks highlands and tunnel roof footprints for this planar robot. It is a model projection, not a SLAM result or localization-validated map.
Referee logic, health replenishment, control capture, RFID dead zones, bullets, external operator rooms and material-dependent magnetic effects are not simulated by this scenery.
